checks.title: PowerShell 7 runtime
checks.expected: PowerShell 7.0 or later.
checks.requiredRole: Local user
checks.remediation: Install a supported PowerShell 7 release and rerun the pre-flight.

checks.title: Microsoft Graph authentication module
checks.expected: Microsoft.Graph.Authentication 2.20.0 or later is available.
checks.requiredRole: Local user
checks.remediation: Install Microsoft.Graph.Authentication explicitly, or rerun with -InstallDependencies to opt in to CurrentUser installation.

checks.title: Microsoft Graph endpoint reachability
checks.expected: The Microsoft Graph endpoint is reachable over HTTPS.
checks.requiredRole: Local user
checks.remediation: Review proxy, firewall, TLS inspection, and DNS settings for graph.microsoft.com.

checks.title: Commercial cloud availability
checks.expected: The tenant uses the Microsoft commercial cloud where Agent 365 is generally available.
checks.requiredRole: Global Reader or another role allowed to read organization metadata
checks.remediation: Confirm Agent 365 availability for the tenant cloud before continuing. Do not infer commercial-cloud capabilities in national clouds.

checks.title: Qualifying Agent 365 service plan assignment
checks.expected: At least one user has the AGENT_365 service plan assigned and enabled.
checks.requiredRole: Global Reader, License Administrator, or equivalent read access
checks.remediation: Assign a qualifying Agent 365 or Microsoft 365 E7 license to at least one pilot user and confirm the AGENT_365 service plan is enabled.

checks.title: Microsoft 365 E5 prerequisite posture
checks.expected: Microsoft 365 E5 is available for the users and capabilities that require it.
checks.requiredRole: Global Reader or License Administrator
checks.remediation: Review feature-level prerequisites. E5 absence is advisory and does not by itself block an Agent 365 pilot.

checks.title: Agent management read role
checks.expected: An active AI Administrator, AI Reader, Global Reader, or Global Administrator role assignment is visible.
checks.requiredRole: Global Reader or Privileged Role Administrator
checks.remediation: Assign the least-privileged Agent 365 management role required for the planned operating model.

checks.title: Eligible management roles
checks.expected: PIM eligibility can be reviewed for Agent 365 management roles when Privileged Identity Management is used.
checks.requiredRole: Global Reader, Security Reader, Security Administrator, Security Operator, or Privileged Role Administrator
checks.remediation: Grant the read permission and supported role if PIM eligibility evidence is required, or validate eligibility manually.

checks.title: Microsoft 365 service health
checks.expected: Service health data is available and no active issues are reported for relevant services.
checks.requiredRole: Service Support Administrator, Global Reader, or another supported service-health role
checks.remediation: Review active incidents and advisories in Microsoft 365 service health before the pilot.

checks.title: Agent package catalog access
checks.expected: The v1.0 Package Management API returns the tenant package catalog.
checks.requiredRole: AI Administrator or Global Administrator
checks.remediation: Grant CopilotPackages.Read.All and assign AI Administrator or Global Administrator as documented for the Package Management API. Treat package results as a catalog summary, not complete agent inventory.

checks.title: Agent identity blueprint inventory
checks.expected: The v1.0 Agent Identity Blueprint API is readable and returns the current blueprint inventory.
checks.requiredRole: Agent ID Administrator for nonowners
checks.remediation: Grant the least-privileged blueprint read permission and supported role, or confirm that no blueprints are in scope.

checks.title: Blueprint owners
checks.expected: Every returned blueprint has at least one owner.
checks.requiredRole: Agent ID Administrator for nonowners
checks.remediation: Assign accountable owners to blueprints that do not have an owner.

checks.title: Blueprint sponsors
checks.expected: Every returned blueprint has at least one lifecycle sponsor.
checks.requiredRole: Agent ID Administrator for nonowners
checks.remediation: Assign lifecycle sponsors to blueprints that do not have a sponsor.

checks.title: Blueprint credential expiry
checks.expected: No returned blueprint credential is expired or expires within 30 days.
checks.requiredRole: Agent ID Administrator for nonowners
checks.remediation: Rotate expiring credentials through the approved identity lifecycle process.

checks.title: Blueprint permission review
checks.expected: Requested resource access is reviewed against least privilege and the agent approval boundary.
checks.requiredRole: Agent ID Administrator and workload owner
checks.remediation: Review requested application roles and delegated scopes. The pre-flight reports counts only and does not approve permissions.

checks.title: Security defaults
checks.expected: Security defaults state is known before Conditional Access policy evidence is interpreted.
checks.requiredRole: Security Reader or Global Reader
checks.remediation: Grant policy read access. Security defaults and Conditional Access for agents must not be evaluated as if both apply.

checks.title: Conditional Access policy inventory
checks.expected: Conditional Access policies are inventoried and manually mapped to each agent access pattern and target resource.
checks.requiredRole: Security Reader, Conditional Access Administrator, or Global Reader
checks.remediation: Review enabled and report-only policies for delegated, app-only, and agent-user flows. API-key access bypasses Conditional Access.

checks.title: Defender AgentsInfo telemetry
checks.expected: An aggregate-only advanced hunting query against AgentsInfo succeeds.
checks.requiredRole: Security Reader or a supported Defender role
checks.remediation: Confirm Agent 365 licensing, Defender enablement, advanced hunting access, and the current AgentsInfo schema.

checks.title: Defender BehaviorInfo telemetry
checks.expected: An aggregate-only advanced hunting query against BehaviorInfo succeeds.
checks.requiredRole: Security Reader or a supported Defender role
checks.remediation: Confirm Defender enablement and review the BehaviorInfo advanced hunting schema.

checks.title: Defender portal controls
checks.expected: Security for AI Agents enablement, connectors, and real-time protection rules are reviewed in the Defender portal.
checks.requiredRole: Security Administrator or delegated security owner
checks.remediation: Validate the Security for AI Agents toggle, connector state, and real-time protection rules in the Defender portal.

checks.title: Purview agent audit evidence
checks.expected: The v1.0 Audit Search API query completes and returns an aggregate count for Copilot and AI interaction operations.
checks.requiredRole: Audit Reader, Audit Manager, or another supported Purview audit role
checks.remediation: Confirm Purview Audit permissions and workload availability. An empty result means no evidence in the selected window, not that auditing is disabled.

checks.title: Purview policy metadata
checks.expected: Available first-party module metadata for DLP, retention, and labels is summarized without treating policy presence as proof of enforcement.
checks.requiredRole: Compliance Reader or delegated Purview role
checks.remediation: Connect the supported first-party compliance PowerShell session before running if metadata evidence is required, then validate policy scope and enforcement manually.

checks.title: SharePoint target-site readiness
checks.expected: Each supplied target site is readable with the supported SharePoint Online module and its agent access boundary is reviewed.
checks.requiredRole: SharePoint Administrator or delegated site administrator
checks.remediation: Supply only intended pilot site URLs, install the first-party SharePoint Online module, and establish a read session before running.

manualAttestations.question: Are accountable owners and lifecycle sponsors assigned for every in-scope agent?
manualAttestations.remediation: Assign owners and sponsors with clear lifecycle accountability.

manualAttestations.question: Are agent approval boundaries, allowed tools, data sources, and permission limits documented?
manualAttestations.remediation: Document the approval boundary before pilot deployment.

manualAttestations.question: Are responsible AI, privacy, and legal reviews complete for the pilot scenario?
manualAttestations.remediation: Complete the applicable responsible AI, privacy, and legal reviews.

manualAttestations.question: Is the security operations incident triage and escalation path documented?
manualAttestations.remediation: Document owners, severity thresholds, escalation paths, and evidence handling.

manualAttestations.question: Are measurable pilot success criteria and review dates documented?
manualAttestations.remediation: Define measurable success, safety, reliability, and adoption criteria.

manualAttestations.question: Is a tested rollback or disablement path documented for every pilot agent?
manualAttestations.remediation: Document how to block, remove, or otherwise contain each agent without data loss.

manualAttestations.question: Is an agent retirement process documented, including access removal and evidence retention?
manualAttestations.remediation: Document retirement ownership, access removal, identity cleanup, and retention requirements.
